title: This MAFEX Doomsday is going to take up some shelf space
body: MAFEX No.325 Doomsday is around 185 mm tall, so he should look properly huge next to the regular comic figures. You get two heads and a torn Superman cape for the display. Release is expected in June 2027, which is still far away. But honestly, this is one character MAFEX collectors have waited a long time for.
tags: MAFEX, Doomsday, DC Comics, Comic Figures

title: Mezco Kingpin is ready for both meetings and fights
body: The new One:12 Kingpin has five heads, a white fabric suit, a cane with effects, a katana and a good number of hands. Quite a lot of action accessories for Wilson Fisk. Shipping is expected between February and April 2027. The figure looks excellent, but keeping that white suit clean in India may be another task altogether.

title: Mezco has revealed Solomon Grundy?
body: The SDCC prototype has a massive body, heavy boots and a dirty, damaged fabric suit. He looks big enough to stand out even in a packed One:12 display. Mezco had not shared the full accessory list or preorder details at the time of the reveal. For now, the size and overall look are already doing most of the work.
tags: Mezco, Solomon Grundy, DC Comics, SDCC 2026

title: Mezco Peacemaker comes with Eagly, as he should
body: The One:12 Peacemaker has the live-action costume, chrome helmet and an Eagly accessory. Mezco has also shown a pistol, rifle, axe, sword and shield, so there should be plenty of posing options. The figure looks good, but we already know Eagly will be the first thing everyone photographs.

title: INART Saruman is now up for preorder
body: INART's official 1/6 Saruman comes with rooted hair and beard, movable eyes, layered robes, ten hands, the staff, two Palantírs, an altar and a display base. The first batch is expected in Q4 2027, and India is included in the supported regions. Long wait and not cheap, but the full Orthanc setup looks very strong.
tags: INART, Saruman, Lord of the Rings, Sixth Scale

title: INART doing Bruce Lee in 1/12 scale
body: The yellow-jumpsuit Bruce Lee is around 15.5 cm tall and still gets a fabric outfit, two heads, twelve hands, nunchaku and a bamboo whip. Shipping is expected in Q4 2026. This scale is much easier to manage for collectors who like INART's work but have no space left for more sixth-scale boxes.
tags: INART, Bruce Lee, One Twelfth Scale, Martial Arts

title: Amazing Yamaguchi Ocelot is made for crazy gun poses
body: Kaiyodo has opened preorders for Revolver Ocelot from Metal Gear Solid Delta. He comes with three revolvers, a knife, gun effects, an extra face and eight hands. Release is planned for April 2027. The main question is whether the shoulder and wrist joints can handle all those signature reload poses without looking awkward.
tags: Amazing Yamaguchi, Revoltech, Metal Gear Solid, Ocelot

title: LPZZ Arkham Knight Catwoman is looking quite good now
body: The latest 1/12 Catwoman photos show the textured suit, red goggles, extra head, multiple hands, whip, binding rope and branded stand. The design stays close to the game and still seems to have decent movement at the shoulders and hips. Now we just need the final production paint to match these promo photos.
tags: LPZZ, Catwoman, Arkham Knight, DC Comics

title: LPZZ Absolute Batman is built like a proper tank
body: LPZZ, also seen under the U-P-Finegures name, has shown its 1/12 Absolute Batman prototype. The figure is around 16 cm tall and keeps the huge proportions from the comic instead of making him slimmer. We still need to see the final paint and full accessory list, but the body sculpt already looks on point.
tags: LPZZ, Absolute Batman, DC Comics, Prototype

title: McFarlane Absolute Batman was the main Funda Expo reveal
body: The Elite Edition figure keeps the huge chest, thick arms and heavy cape shape from the comic. In the US it is planned as a Walmart exclusive, while Canada gets it through EB Games. Availability for other markets is still unclear, so Indian collectors may be better off waiting for local importer listings instead of rushing into an overseas preorder.
tags: McFarlane, Absolute Batman, DC Multiverse, Funda Expo 2026

title: Nottaa Aragorn looks amazing but the two versions can be confusing
body: YuanYe Culture and Nottaa have opened preorders for their officially licensed 1/12 Aragorn. The figure is around 170 mm tall with movable eyes, fabric clothing, sword, dagger, bow, arrows, pipe and plenty of hands. The standard version has sculpted hair, while the collector's edition adds rooted hair and a larger stone-style base. Shipping is expected in Q1 2027. Which version would you pick?
tags: Nottaa Xtreme, Aragorn, Lord of the Rings, One Twelfth Scale

title: Nottaa is giving the Nazgûl a horse in 1/12 scale
body: The new Nazgûl set includes a 17 cm Ringwraith and a black steed standing around 22 cm tall. You also get a long sword, short sword, six hands, stand and base. Release is currently expected between April and June 2027. A mounted Ringwraith will need serious shelf space, but this could become the main piece in a 1/12 Middle-earth display.
tags: Nottaa Xtreme, Nazgul, Lord of the Rings, Horse Figure

title: INART's new 1/12 Joker comes with a proper accessory loadout
body: INART Action's comic-style Joker stands around 16.9 cm and comes with smiling and laughing heads, fourteen hands and nine accessories. The box includes a flag revolver, submachine gun, cane, crowbar, Joker Fish, dagger, acid flower, Joker teeth and playing cards. Shipping is expected in Q1 2027, with India listed as a supported region. This one should be very fun to pose.
tags: INART, Joker, DC Comics, One Twelfth Scale

title: SHF Nanami finally gets his overtime look
body: S.H.Figuarts Kento Nanami is coming in the jacket-off, sleeves-rolled look from his later fights. He gets the wrapped machete, three faces, flowing-hair parts and the tie-wrapped fist. The weapon can also sit on his back, which will help with simpler poses. Preorders opened on 1 September. Bandai knew exactly which Nanami version collectors were waiting for.
tags: S.H.Figuarts, Kento Nanami, Jujutsu Kaisen, Bandai

title: SHF Mahito's Domain Expansion face is completely wild
body: The new S.H.Figuarts Mahito comes with four faces, movable hair and a softer upper-body costume so the figure can still pose properly. The standout is the Domain Expansion face with the hand coming out of his mouth. You also get bonus face parts for the newer Yuji and Todo figures. Strange accessory, but absolutely the right one for Mahito.

title: SHF Vegeta gets a new Cell Saga body
body: Bandai's new Z-Fighters Vegeta uses the Android and Cell Saga look with updated proportions and a new movable shoulder setup. He comes with folded arms, three faces, four pairs of hands, extra feet and a flowing-hair head part. Release is planned for April 2027. Another Vegeta, yes, but this one looks made for the classic Z-Fighters shelf.
tags: S.H.Figuarts, Vegeta, Dragon Ball Z, Z-Fighters

title: SHF Trunks joins the Z-Fighters lineup with his sword
body: The new Z-Fighters Trunks comes in the black tank-top look with his sword and sheath, four faces, six pairs of hands and two hair options. The first production run also includes the Type-B group display base, which connects with the other Z-Fighters bases. Release is planned for March 2027. Nice idea, but now collectors will want to complete the full opening lineup.
tags: S.H.Figuarts, Trunks, Dragon Ball Z, Z-Fighters

title: Sexy Ice has teased B200 Locust, and it already looks nasty
body: Sexy Ice has shown the first teaser for B200 Locust from the VERMIN series. The design mixes an insect-like body, zombie elements and military armour, which sounds odd but somehow works. No full accessory list, price or release date yet, so this is only a first look. Sexy Ice has been moving fast with this line. Waiting for the full reveal now.
tags: Sexy Ice, B200 Locust, VERMIN, Original IP

title: Wonder Festival Shanghai is back on 3-4 October
body: Wonder Festival Shanghai 2026 will be held at the Shanghai New International Expo Centre on 3 and 4 October. Expect major figure brands, garage-kit makers, independent sculptors, new reveals and plenty of event-only items. This is one event where going without a plan is a bad idea. Check the exhibitor map early, mark the priority booths and keep some bag space for unexpected purchases.
tags: Wonder Festival, WF Shanghai, Figure Event, Garage Kits

body: The new One Piece OP-17 set focuses on Elbaph and includes Luffy, Loki, the Straw Hats and members of the Rocks Pirates. It also includes a manga-style Super Leader alternate-art card for Luffy.

title: Magic: The Gathering – Reality Fracture

title: Yu-Gi-Oh World Championship pack
body: Yu-Gi-Oh has released a 21-card set for the 2026 World Championship. It includes alternate-art cards inspired by traditional Japanese Ukiyo-e artwork.
